original_benchmark_body_smoke.scope: Unchanged original benchmark bodies in minimal isolated original-package composition; not full project/optimization measurement

authored_native_control.scope: Original broker and local components; synthetic retriever returns owned chunks and cancels context; no service/network

findings: NewBroker normalizes negative TargetK to8; SetConfig stores same negative value without normalization, and ProcessChunks withMMRdisabled panics via negative SelectTopK. Native constructor/setter controls confirm.

Synthetic retriever cancels context before returning valid chunks; original Broker.Retrieve continues clustering/selection and returns2chunks,nilerror whilectx canceled. This demonstrates absent post-retrieval cancellation gate, not actual provider behavior or latency.
Retrieve overwrites caller req.TopK1 with configured OverFetchK50 and forces embeddings. Intentional broker overfetch policy, not declared strict caller cap; caller object mutation confirmed.
Broker constructs SelectorConfig with strategy only, leaving hybrid weights0 and therefore falling back to score. Source observation; no separate full hybrid broker control.
All eight original benchmark functions execute once and exit0 without original source edits. No correctness assertions in these benchmark bodies, no speedup claim.
transfer_decision: Normalize configuration consistently and make cancellation, request-mutation and resource-admission contracts explicit. No foreign production implementation copied.
limits: No original unit suite/full dependencies/services/platform/race validation.
Eight one-iteration benchmark bodies are smoke checks only.
